correctness.rationale: Exact output-multiplicity formula from original gap deletion; all possible source multiplicities partition into ordinary, nonordinary m>=3, and m=2. In nonordinary m>=3, all but one low gap are PF. Their products with source m force a single omitted gap; PF1 contradiction makes its index 1. PF(m-1) and source (m+2) force 2m+1, then closure forces a full tail. Each remaining source family is verified almost symmetric and maps to the asserted target. Exhaustive finite test F<=20: 601 sources, 46 multiplicity-two outputs; VERIFY_OK. The infinite argument is independent of this computation.

value.rationale: The motivating paper explicitly poses characterization of image and documents substantial noninjectivity. This theorem completely classifies a natural infinite target stratum (least positive member 2), proves it contains no nonclosed target, and exhibits a sharp fiber-cardinality transition (infinitely many preimages for g=1,2, uniquely itself for g>=3). The exact inverse sets provide mathematical reconstruction information beyond known missing-1 obstructions and finite enumeration.
